description_en: Queries the list of all clusters in each region under your account
description_zh: 查询用户账号中在每个地域拥有的所有集群的列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-clusters --cluster-ids ehpc-cn-wulanchabu-llsu000000 --cluster-names slurm22.05.8-cluster-20240802 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListClusters

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the clusters to query. Valid values of N: 0 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 待查询集群ID。N的取值范围：0～20
parameters.name: cluster_ids

parameters.help_en: The names of the clusters to query. Valid values of N: 0 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的集群名称列表。N的取值范围：0～20
parameters.name: cluster_names

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Settings the number of rows per page for paging. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围：10~100。 默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size
